# PipeLang-owned offline build of the pinned upstream source selection.
file(SHA256 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/FILES.sha256" yaml_inventory_sha256)
if(NOT yaml_inventory_sha256 STREQUAL "b8bb60fa71f8e1663f8447d24dc628eb5c5d10b9d4e4d6f6abbdeb59ba8cebfd")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Pinned yaml-cpp source inventory checksum mismatch")
endif()
file(STRINGS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/FILES.sha256" yaml_source_records)
set(yaml_sources)
foreach(record IN LISTS yaml_source_records)
    string(SUBSTRING "${record}" 0 64 expected)
    string(SUBSTRING "${record}" 66 -1 relative)
    file(SHA256 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${relative}" actual)
    if(NOT actual STREQUAL expected)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Pinned yaml-cpp checksum mismatch: ${relative}")
    endif()
    if(relative MATCHES "[.]cpp$")
        list(APPEND yaml_sources "${relative}")
    endif()
endforeach()
add_library(pipelang_yaml STATIC ${yaml_sources})
target_compile_features(pipelang_yaml PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
target_compile_definitions(pipelang_yaml PUBLIC YAML_CPP_STATIC_DEFINE)
target_include_directories(pipelang_yaml SYSTEM PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
target_include_directories(pipelang_yaml PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src")
set_target_properties(pipelang_yaml PROPERTIES CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
